scope: Item 4 public focus/keyboard/pointer/capture/cancellation/focus-loss/deactivation/delete/rebind/retire closure, external authoritative display + native IME client boundary, and public accessibility/platform capability boundary.
implemented: TextInputSession owns one focus slot and correlates native display focus, preedit serials, cancellation delivery state and permanent retirement
ExternalInputService exposes exact cancellation envelopes through an injected host transport; success means queued, not acknowledged
failed cancellation delivery keeps the exact owner/composition envelope for ordered retry
authoritative display revision must strictly advance; equal, older, stale-expected and wrong-lineage snapshots cause no display mutation
successful display replacement rotates the input ticket and makes the old ticket/composition unusable
scene focus-loss event helper rejects stale/foreign nodes before cancelling the matching input session
focus loss/deactivation/removal/retirement close local focus/preedit before service cancellation and preserve failed pointer/service work for explicit retry
public PlatformBridgeCapabilities distinguishes engine-provided display/accessibility from host-owned text/IME/window/platform accessibility services

cases: Ime disabled cancels exact composition; unavailable transport is pending; retry repeats the same envelope once and late preedit stays rejected
authoritative revision successor rotates owner and clears old composition; equal/older/stale snapshots are rejected
focus loss closes local focus before pointer release recovery and service cancellation retry
display and capture retirement permanently block reopening while retaining failed release/cancellation for retry
scene deletion reports focus loss, stale scene events have no effects, new target rebinds and accessibility tree excludes the deleted node
duplicate pointer up cannot repeat activation; deactivation clears focus and press
